formal_statement: ∀ m : ℕ, 8 ≤ m → ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.Search.QLine (Fin (2 ^ (8 * m) + 1) × Fin (8 * m))), PEqualNP.Search.IsResLinQRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ (8 * m) + 1) (8 * m)) π → ∃ L ∈ π, 2 ^ m < L.length
plain_statement: For m >= 8, every Res(lin) refutation over the integers (any coefficients) of the bit pigeonhole principle with 2^(8m)+1 pigeons and 2^(8m) holes has a line with more than 2^m equations, so width n^(1/8). Proof: a Delayer walk with the Erdos-Littlewood-Offord inequality. Witnesses that L-lib-091 is vacuous; possibly new.
title: Res(lin) over the integers needs lines of n^Omega(1) equations on bit PHP
